subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI issue remain the umbrella, or should maintainers split it across the existing structured reply-context and durable final-fallback trackers?
rationale: The source-reproducible gaps are real, but the permanent fix spans UI request schema, Gateway protocol, agent runtime metadata, and channel delivery semantics, with active related items already owning different slices.

options.title: Split Across Existing Trackers
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after the split is explicit.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the coordination tracker until one accepted design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only final-fallback delivery semantics active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Trackers
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after the split is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent area work touch the UI send path, Gateway schema, runtime-context boundary, and fallback-related contracts that need coordination.
